# Protein function {#sec-protein-function}

::: {.callout-note title="From the exam description"}
Classifications, prediction methods, and definitions.
:::

## Introduction

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
Short introduction: what "function" means (molecular, cellular,
biological); controlled vocabularies (GO, EC); annotation transfer by
homology and its pitfalls; non-homology methods (genomic context,
networks); prediction of sorting signals and localisation; predicting the
effect of variants; how function prediction is evaluated (CAFA).
:::

## Key concepts

- Definitions of function; Gene Ontology (MF, BP, CC), evidence codes, EC numbers
- Annotation transfer by homology: identity thresholds, domain architecture, orthologs vs. paralogs, error propagation
- Family/domain-based annotation (Pfam, InterPro)
- Genomic-context methods: gene fusion (Rosetta stone), gene neighbourhood, phylogenetic profiles
- Network-based function prediction (guilt by association; see @sec-protein-interactions)
- Structure-based function prediction
- Sorting signals and subcellular localisation: signal peptides, transmembrane regions, SignalP, DeepLoc
- Variant effect prediction: conservation, unsupervised models (EVE), AlphaMissense
- Critical assessment: CAFA; why function prediction is hard to evaluate

## Key papers

::: {.callout-tip}
★ = mandatory in earlier reading lists.
:::

### Reviews — start here

- @whisstock2003 — prediction of protein function from sequence and structure.
- @radivojac2013 — CAFA: large-scale evaluation of function prediction.
- @zhou2019 — CAFA3.

### Ontologies

- @ashburner2000 — the Gene Ontology.
- @go2023 — the Gene Ontology knowledgebase in 2023.

### Genomic context and non-homology methods

- @marcotte1999science — detecting function and interactions from genome sequences (Rosetta stone).
- @marcotte1999nature — a combined algorithm for genome-wide function prediction.
- @tsoka2000 — metabolic enzymes are frequently involved in gene fusion.
- @enright2001 — functional associations from exhaustive detection of gene fusions.
- @snel2000 — gene fusion versus gene fission.
- @doolittle1999 — "Do you dig my groove?" (commentary on the above).
- ★ @garzon2016 — a computational interactome and functional annotation of the human proteome.

### Sorting signals and localisation

- @vonheijne1986 — a new method for predicting signal-sequence cleavage sites.
- @nielsen1997 — SignalP: neural-network prediction of signal peptides.
- @petersen2011 — SignalP 4.0: discriminating signal peptides from transmembrane regions.
- @teufel2022 — SignalP 6.0: all types of signal peptides with protein language models.
- ★ @almagro2017 — DeepLoc: subcellular localisation with deep learning.
- @thumuluri2022 — DeepLoc 2.0.

### Variant effect prediction

- @frazer2021 — EVE: disease variant prediction from evolutionary data.
- @cheng2023 — AlphaMissense.
